ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black border concentrated along the trailing edge and lateral tips. Parallel black linear bands on the upper left lobe. Two isolated dark circular clusters located symmetrically in the lower-mid quadrant of each lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute angle of approximately 35 degrees and high depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration pattern spanning the entire posterior boundary, characterized by sharp jagged peaks and deep recessed valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward concave trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular low-intensity pixel clusters positioned symmetrically in the lower-middle region of each fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Group of 6-8 parallel dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the upper-left lobe; single diagonal linear disruption on the far left lateral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular erosion and tissue loss along the trailing edge boundary; distinct rake marks on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique symmetrical placement of two dark focal spots within the central white field.
